address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x76`. Another address can be `0x77`.

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*

gas_resistance.docs:
The information for the gas sensor.

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*

duration.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The duration the heater should be active. Maximum value is `4032ms`. Defaults to `150ms`.

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*

temperature.docs:
**int**: The target temperature of the heater between 200 and 400 °C. Defaults to `320`.

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*

heater.docs:
The settings for the internal heater for the gas sensor. Set this to disable the internal heater.

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*

oversampling.docs:
The oversampling parameter for the temperature sensor. See [Oversampling Options](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#bme680-oversampling).

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*

humidity.docs:
The information for the humidity sensor.

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*

iir_filter.docs:
Set up an Infinite Impulse Response filter to increase accuracy. One of `OFF`, `1x`, `3x`, `7x`, `15x`, `31x`, `63x` and `127x`. Defaults to `OFF`.

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*

oversampling.docs:
The oversampling parameter for the temperature sensor. See [Oversampling Options](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#bme680-oversampling).

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*

**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [BME680 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity+Gas Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bme680#configuration-variables)*
